intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} are both public Delhi University colleges offering {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, and both are listed with CUET UG. This page compares recorded year fees, 2023 placements and India Today ranks from our table, with official sites opened in {{year}}.
Miranda House vs Ramjas College is a North Campus science comparison. Miranda House holds India Today ranks of 2 in 2024 and 2023 on our records. Ramjas College is listed at 20 in 2024.

sections.heading: Miranda House vs Ramjas College for BSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Miranda House if you want recorded Total Fees of ₹19,200 a year for B.Sc (Hons) Mathematics, or ₹20,700 for physics, chemistry, zoology and botany, with a 2023 mathematics row of ₹9 lakh average and ₹22 lakh highest, and an India Today rank of 2.

Choose Ramjas College if you want that campus and subject, with recorded year tuition of ₹13,500 and ₹15,275 on the same honours rows, a 2023 mathematics row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest, and an India Today rank of 20 in 2024.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Miranda House we hold Total Fees year figures of ₹19,200 for mathematics honours, ₹19,490 for B.Sc Physical Sciences, ₹20,690 for Life Sciences, and ₹20,700 for physics, chemistry, zoology and botany honours.

For Ramjas College we hold two year tuition figures, ₹13,500 and ₹15,275, on the same programme rows for mathematics, physics, chemistry, statistics, zoology and botany. We have not chosen one as official, and we have not added them together.
These are year figures, not confirmed official three-year totals. Confirm the current notices on mirandahouse.ac.in and ramjas.du.ac.in.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Miranda House has a 2023 B.Sc (Hons) Mathematics row of ₹9 lakh average and ₹22 lakh highest. Ramjas College has a 2023 mathematics row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest.
A 2010 Ramjas row is also stored. Do not treat 2010 as a current figure. These 2023 rows are for mathematics, not for every B.Sc subject.
Ask both campuses for a later official science report if you need broader figures.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both are listed with CUET UG. Follow the official CUET UG and Delhi University admissions process.
On our records, Miranda House has India Today ranks of 2 in 2024, 2023 and 2021. Ramjas College has India Today ranks of 20 in 2024 and 18 in 2023. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are public colleges in Delhi, so a local student can visit them on the same day. Miranda House is a women's college. Ramjas College is co-educational.
Ramjas College also lists statistics honours, which Miranda House does not list on this page. Match the subject and the college type, not only the rank.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Miranda House if the India Today rank of 2, the 2023 mathematics placement row and a women's college campus fit you, after official fee confirmation.
Pick Ramjas College if that co-educational campus and subject are the offer you have, after you confirm which of the two recorded tuition figures is current.
Do not add Ramjas College's two tuition rows into a total we have not confirmed.

faqs.question: What BSc fees are on record for Miranda House and Ramjas College?
faqs.answer: Miranda House has Total Fees year figures of ₹19,200 to ₹20,700, depending on the science stream. Ramjas College has two year tuition figures, ₹13,500 and ₹15,275, on the same honours rows. We have not added the Ramjas figures together.

faqs.question: How do 2023 placements compare?
faqs.answer: Miranda House has a 2023 mathematics row of ₹9 lakh average and ₹22 lakh highest. Ramjas College has a 2023 mathematics row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest. These rows are for mathematics, not every B.Sc subject.

faqs.question: Which college has the better India Today rank?
faqs.answer: Miranda House is listed at 2 in 2024, 2023 and 2021. Ramjas College is listed at 20 in 2024 and 18 in 2023. These are not NIRF ranks.

faqs.question: How does admission work?
faqs.answer: Both colleges are listed with CUET UG. Follow the official CUET UG and Delhi University admissions process.

faqs.question: Is Miranda House a women's college?
faqs.answer: Yes. Miranda House is a women's college. Ramjas College is co-educational. Both are public colleges in Delhi.

faqs.question: Does Ramjas College offer statistics honours?
faqs.answer: Yes. Statistics honours is listed at Ramjas College on this page. Miranda House does not list that subject here.
